title: Open Values Collective v0.1
description: A group's values, worked out in the browser by averaging several people's values files. It records how far apart the group is on each value and includes a values file for the group that any app can read. The Assembly page at /assembly/ makes it.

format.description: Always "open-values-collective". Tells a reader that this file is a group's values, added up.

version.description: The version of the collective format this file follows, 0.1.

name.description: What the group called itself, or 'an assembly'.

n.description: How many values files were added up. The file cannot tell how many people are behind them.

members.description: A label for each file, as its owner gave it. Not a name unless someone typed one.

values.description: The group's mean weight, 0 to 5, for each shared value at least one file gave. A value no file gave is left out, not set to 0.

agreement.description: For each value in values: the mean, the spread, a consensus from 0 (split) to 1 (all the same), and how many files gave it.

mean.description: The average weight the files gave this value, from 0 to 5, rounded to two decimal places.

sd.description: How spread out the weights were (the standard deviation), rounded to two decimal places. 0 means every file gave the same weight.

consensus.description: How much the files agree, from 0 (split, as when half say 0 and half say 5) to 1 (all the same). Worked out as 1 minus the spread divided by 2.5, and never below 0.

voices.description: How many files gave a weight for this value.

dissent.description: The values in agreement, most split first.

passport.description: A values file for the group, with the group's average weights and its name as the source, so any app that reads values files can use it.
